source.note: Modbus 'address' values below are the 0-based register addresses used directly in the source YAML's 'address:' field (Home Assistant Modbus integration convention). Sungrow's own datasheet register numbers, quoted in the source file's inline comments, are address+1.

register_map.name: grid_power
register_map._source: modbus_sungrow.yaml lines 401-414, 'Meter active power', input_type: input, data_type: int32, swap: word. Comment: '> 0 buy from grid; < 0 sell to grid' -- already matches required convention (positive=import, negative=export), no sign flip needed.

register_map.name: pv_power
register_map._source: modbus_sungrow.yaml lines 259-271, 'Total DC power', input_type: input, data_type: uint32, swap: word. Cross-confirmed by evcc templates/definition/meter/sungrow-hybrid.yaml line ~125 (pv power source, address 5016, decode uint32s).

register_map.name: battery_power
register_map._source: modbus_sungrow.yaml lines 369-384, 'Battery power', input_type: input, data_type: int32, swap: word. Comment: 'negative: Battery charging / positive: Battery discharging'. This is the OPPOSITE of the required convention (positive=charging), so scale=-1 is applied to flip the sign.
